flows.title: Create a board
steps: Select Create in the header, then Create Board.
Enter a title for the board.
Select the Workspace to create the board in.

flows.title: Add a card
steps: Select Add a card at the bottom of a list.
Type a name for the card.
Press Enter to create the card.

flows.title: Move a card
steps: Within a board, click and drag the card up or down its list, or to another list.
To move it to a different board, click the context menu in the top right of the card and choose Move. Or open the card, click the actions menu (…) at the top, and select Move.

flows.title: Search for cards
steps: Type in the search box at the very top of the page.
For more filters, click Advanced search at the bottom of the search window, or go to trello.com/search.
